occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information regarding how care will continue in the event of an emergency evacuation of the home.

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information on how children will be accounted for in the event of an emergency evacuation of the home.
